text:
linh: quick heads-up — after merging 2.4.1 -> prod, eu-west embeddings p99 is +3.2% vs baseline over last 6m. deploy-bot shows 60% traffic. thinking manual rollback vs short pin. can ops weigh in? logs + commands below.

deploy-bot: ALERT: metric embeddings.p99_eu = +3.2% (6m window). auto-rollback not configured for this route. Traffic: 60% -> scheduled to 100% in 10m unless held. runbook: if breach persists 10m -> roll back. :warning:

parth: are we seeing real user impact or just synthetic load?

maya: small user regressions on long-tail queries (longer embedding requests). not errors, but latency visible in session traces. examples: query ids 7842, 7845.

linh: ops options: 1) manual rollback to v2.4.0 2) pin traffic to 30% and continue probe 3) rollforward a tiny patch. my preference: pin + notify + run evals against our prompt set.

sre-oncall: prefer pin to 30% for now. if p99 stays >2% over next 10m we trigger manual rollback. i'll be ready to execute. @parth can you prep the rollback blurb for customers?

parth: on it. draft: 'We are reverting a model update in eu-west affecting embeddings latency; initiating rollback to maintain latency SLOs. No data access or schema changes. We will update once complete.' will post to #customer-alerts once approved.

maya: ops commands: to pin -> `redwoodctl traffic split set --route embeddings-eu-west --weight 30% --model v2.4.1`
rollback command -> `redwoodctl rollout set --route embeddings-eu-west --model v2.4.0 --force`
(also: `redwoodctl status --route embeddings-eu-west` to watch).

deploy-bot: ACTION: automatic promotion suppressed. awaiting operator confirmation for manual changes.

linh: executing traffic pin now to 30%. will report back in 5m. @sre-oncall please watch p99/errors and call rollback if it worsens.

sre-oncall: pinned to 30% — p99 dropped to +0.8% after 4m. keeping pin for 20m and running the eval job. no customer message posted yet.

parth: release-note draft approved. posting to #customer-alerts and adding a short note to the changelog. :white_check_mark:

linh: thanks everyone. leaving thread open for the next 30m. if p99 creeps back we'll do manual rollback and update customers.
